# An unobtrusive QOL modpack

[![Discord link](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d004757580be21c77a3b9608cbf29ad50214295.png)](https://discord.gg/qtB3F6tyBc)
[![Website link](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8b1aeb83d142fc872c8fe2ccade6b8729179bb0.png)](https://notkirb.com/)

![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/pqBBMLjA?style=for-the-badge)
![Modrinth Game Versions](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/game-versions/pqBBMLjA?style=for-the-badge)
[![Built with Seedpack](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20with%20-%20Seedpack%20-%20green?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/notkirb/seedpack)

---

Kirbium is an unobtrusive performance and utility modpack. It includes mods that improve performance, and QOL mods like Xaero's WM/MM (MM hidden by default) and Jade. Kirbium focuses on keeping true to the vanilla experience, while making simple interactions easier and faster.

## Mods

#### QOL
| Mod | Description |
| --- | --- |
| AppleSkin | Hunger bar improvements |
| e4mc | Let friends outside your network join a LAN server |
| Elytra Chestplate Swapper | Keybind to swap chestplate and elytra |
| Gamma Utils | Fullbright mod |
| Jade | Show a description of what you are looking at | 
| Litematica | Schematic mod |
| Mouse tweaks | Makes inventory management easier | 
| Resourceify | Download and update resources in-game | 
| Simple Voice Chat | In-game proximity voice chat |
| uku's Armor HUD | Shows armor on your hotbar |
| Zoomify | Press C to zoom |
| Remove Reloading Screen | Removes the reloading screen |
| Shulker Box Tooltip | Shows shulker box contents in tooltip |

#### Performance

| Mod | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Sodium | Rendering optimizations |
| Lithium | Game optimizations |
| BadOptimizations | Game optimizations |
| ImmediatelyFast | Rendering optimizations
| More culling | Render culling |
| FerriteCore | Memory optimizations |
| C2ME | Chunk optimizations | 
| Very many players | Server optimizations |

#### Graphics
| Mod | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Iris | Shader support |
| Sodium Extra | OptiFine-like graphics options |
| Continuity | Continuous textures |

#### Misc
| Mod | Description |
| --- | --- |
| kennytv's epic force close loading screen for Fabric | |
| Litematica Downloader | Download schematics |
| Mod Menu | Manage mod configs |
| OptiGUI | OptiFine custom GUIs |
| Packet Fixer | |
| Puzzle | |
| Reese's Sodium Options | Enhanced Sodium Options GUI |
| spark | Performance profiler |
| WorldEdit | Powerful in-game world editor |

> Kirbium uses a modpack building tool called Seedpack.
